title: Sweep spilled nuts into a dustpan
instruction: Sweep all the spilled nuts into the dustpan with the hand brush, then lift the dustpan off the table.
context: Small parts spilled across a workbench are too many to pick up one at a time. A dustpan slides away unless it is held, and when the spill is wider than one arm's reach, the hands have to swap the brush and the dustpan.
setup: Positions are measured on the workbench from the midpoint between the two arm bases (61 cm apart): x forward, y to the left. 10 steel M8 hex nuts (13 mm across flats, 6.5 mm thick, 5 g each) lie flat in two piles of five, each spread over about 6 x 8 cm at x 30-36 cm: one at y -16 to -24 cm (right), one at y +16 to +24 cm (left). A plastic dustpan (floor 20 x 12 cm, 2 mm thick, with a 2.5 cm sloped front lip, a 4 cm back wall, 3 cm side walls, and a 14 cm handle bar parallel to the back wall, 12 cm behind the floor's centre and 4.5 cm up, joined to the wall by two posts, 150 g) is centred at x 20 cm, y 0, its mouth facing away from the robot. A hand brush (a 14 x 4 x 3 cm wooden block, 80 g) lies lengthwise, pointing away from the robot, at x 16 cm, y -20 cm, right of the dustpan. Exact nut positions are in the README.
scoring: At the end: a nut counts if its centre is over the dustpan's floor, inside its walls and less than 3 cm above the dustpan's base. Nuts on the lip, the table or the floor count 0, and so does a nut that was carried rather than swept: one whose lowest point rose more than 2 cm above the table outside the dustpan at any time during the trial. With the dustpan lifted (its lowest point at least 5 cm above the table) and tilted no more than 30 degrees: 0.1 per nut (all 10: 1.0). With the dustpan on the table and tilted no more than 30 degrees: 0.05 per nut. Dustpan tilted more than 30 degrees or upside down: 0.
fidelity: The brush is a rigid 14 x 4 x 3 cm block without bristles, so it pushes the nuts with a flat face rather than sweeping them. The nuts are plain hexagonal prisms without a threaded hole or chamfers. The dustpan is rigid, with a 1 mm sloped lip instead of a flexible rubber edge. Friction coefficients (static/dynamic) are estimates: nuts 0.4/0.35, dustpan 0.3/0.25, brush 0.4/0.3.
